easyPrerequisites: There are legal target(s) for Essence Flux.
description:
Cast Essence Flux by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost plus commander tax if applicable
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Essence Flux, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Essence Flux, blinking Naru Meha.
Repeat from step 3.
